description: Fetch the genres of one catalog edition by its AT-URI. This is an anonymous catalog read served by the bibliograph edge from the catalog tables; it is never handled by HappyView. Genres come from OpenLibrary subjects and Goodreads book pages, mapped to a curated vocabulary.

uri.description: AT-URI of the edition these genres belong to.
AT-URI of the edition these genres belong to.

genres.description: Genres in provider order; empty when none are known yet.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The uri is missing, malformed, or not an edition record URI.

errors.name: RecordNotFound
errors.description: No catalog edition has that URI.
